title: KeenTouchstone Cassette TraceEvent
description: One line of an append-only JSONL cassette = the ground truth of an agent run, enabling deterministic replay of harness orchestration logic given frozen model/tool outputs. A Cassette file is a stream of these objects (JSONL). $id is a placeholder.

step_id.description: == Span.harness.step_id. Linear replay order; per-kind cursors index off this.

timestamp.description: Recorded wall-clock time. Replay serves this via clock virtualization.

input.description: Exact recorded input. On replay, stubs assert the replay input matches this (divergence detection).

output.description: Recorded output, returned verbatim by the replay stub with zero network.

metadata.description: model_id / tool_id etc. Replay VALIDATES these match the live call; mismatch = divergence, not silent fallthrough.
